hadith.chapterTitle: The Obligation of Hajj (Pilgrimage) and its Excellence
hadith.body:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Whoever performs Hajj (pilgrimage) and does not have sexual relations (with his wife), nor commits sin, nor disputes unjustly (during Hajj), then he returns from Hajj as pure and free from sins as on the day on which his mother gave birth to him."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim].
- وعنه قال سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول‏:‏ ‏"‏من حج، فلم يرفث ولم يفسق، رجع كيوم ولدته أمه‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏

Abu Hurairah (Semoga Allah meredainya) melaporkan: Rasulullah (ﷺ) bersabda, "Sesiapa yang mengerjakan haji dan tidak melakukan hubungan seksual (dengan isterinya), tidak melakukan dosa, dan tidak bertengkar secara tidak adil (semasa haji), maka dia akan kembali daripada haji dalam keadaan suci dan bebas daripada dosa seumpama hari ketika ibunya melahirkannya." [Al-Bukhari dan Muslim].
